newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bear Stearns starts broadcasters.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bear Stearns starts broadcasters.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Victor Milller started four broadcasters, including Granite Broadcasting Corp, Young Broadcasting Inc, LIN Television Corp and Sinclair Broadcast Group Inc.
-- Miller said he rated Young as buy, Granite as attractive, and LIN and Sinclair as neutral.
-- The analyst said he set 12-month price targets of $40 on Young and $14 on Granite.
-- He said he expected Young to earn about $0.14 in the current year and about $0.54 per share in 1997.
-- Miller declined to reveal his earnings estimates on the other three broadcasters.

-- In early trading Thursday, Young shares rose 3/4 to 28 and Granite was up 1/4 point to 10-3/4. LIN Television was off 1/8 to 41-7/8 and Sinclair stood at 26-3/4, unchanged from the previous day's close.
